about_the_game:
14: Overmind is a survival adventure game that takes place in an unknown sector of space being torn apart by anomaly formations.

You wake up among the wreckage of your ship in the cold silence of space. Reality around you is torn apart, obeying unknown laws. Each new sector is a challenge: anomaly zones change the rules of the game. Upgrade your spacesuit to withstand extreme conditions. Explore the world in search of answers and traces of other survivors. Gather resources to build a spaceship and set up an autonomous base. Your goal is not just to survive, but to conquer a new, hostile space.

EXPLORE UNKNOWN SPACE

Journey into the anomalous zones where the fabric of reality itself is distorted. Here, gravity can suddenly reverse, and space can twist into a loop, turning simple movement into a complex puzzle. But the main threat comes from fractals — creatures from another dimension whose nature defies the laws of physics. Each type requires a unique tactic: some cannot be tracked in three-dimensional space, while others manipulate time or matter. An encounter with them is always unpredictable and deadly dangerous.

CONTROL IMMERSIVE TRANSPORT

Feel like a real spaceship pilot. Take control of every vehicle with immersive manual controls. Directly interact with the systems: steer the ship yourself, adjust engine power, and activate support systems. Master your skills to adapt your piloting to any situation, from precise maneuvering in narrow anomaly rifts to rapid escape from danger.

USE HIGH-TECH EQUIPMENT

Your exosuit is your key to survival. Equipped with a range of high-tech tools, it opens up new possibilities for interacting with an unfamiliar world. Control objects from a distance with a gravity manipulator, cut open mineral formations with a laser cutter, and use a defractalizer to research the most unusual finds, capable of moving objects from another dimension into our familiar space. And that's just a fraction of the capabilities of your arsenal.

GATHER RARE RESOURCES

In addition to recycling wrecked ships, explore asteroid fields and planetoid surfaces to extract rare ores and minerals born in the depths of anomalies. These resources are essential for upgrading your equipment, setting up your base or building your spaceship.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX570 / Intel ARC A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX6700 / Intel ARC A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 9 GB available space

short_description: You are alone in space. Reality is torn apart by anomalies, and space obeys its own incomprehensible laws. To survive, you must adapt, using advanced technology to gather resources, build a ship and setup a base. Will you be able to find your way home?
supported_languages:
English*, Russian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
